params.body:
## What

How many cars stand on the shared stocklist, over time, on two screens:

- **Beheer > Inzichten, tab Klanten en omzet**: a block "Wagens op de stocklist" under the window choice. The answer first ("Nu **1.248 wagens** op de stocklist, 62 meer dan 30 dagen geleden."), then one bar per counted evening over the chosen window (6, 12 or 24 months), labelled "Gemeten sinds <date>".
- **The garage's own Inzichten (`/my-insights`)**: a block "Op de stocklist" with the same chart for the garage's own cars, built from the insights components (block, answer, note) and the existing `_chart` partial.

## Where the numbers come from

There was no history: the stocklist is a set of flags on the vehicles, and a flag that goes off leaves no trace. This adds one:

- Table `stocklist_daily` (date, dealer_id, cars): one row per garage per day, plus one row for the whole platform (`dealer_id` 0) that is written every evening, also at zero. A day with that row is a counted day, so a garage without a row on it had no car on the stocklist, and a day without it is a gap.
- Command `stocklist:size-daily`, scheduled in `routes/console.php` at 23:50 Europe/Brussels. A second run on the same day replaces the first.
- The count is the stocklist's own definition and is not written out again: `Vehicle::onStocklist()` without the demo accounts, the way `StocklistBrowser` counts its groups and makes (`App\Support\StocklistSize::query`).

"Now" in the answer is the count of this moment, and it is also today's bar (drawn lighter). The comparison is with the last count at least 30 days back; until one exists the answer says from which date the comparison is possible.

## Measured only, no estimated history

The reconstruction from dates on the vehicles is left out. It cannot work on this schema:

- `available_on_stocklist_date` is written when a car is entered, whether or not it ever goes on the stocklist (`OwnStockService`), so the date is no evidence that a car stood on it.
- A sale switches `available_on_stocklist` off (`Sale::sold`), and taking a car off has no timestamp.

So for every car that is sold or taken off, nothing says whether it was ever on the stocklist. The only cars a reconstruction can place are the ones on it today, and counting those backwards draws a line that rises toward today whatever really happened. Its value for today equals the measured count, but only because it is the same set of cars; that agreement says nothing about any earlier day. A chart of it would show growth that is an artefact, so the screens show measured days only, starting at the first count: no bar and no zero before it.

This was decided from the code paths that write these columns. It was not checked against production figures.

## Details

- Over more than 120 counted days a bar is a month, holding the count of its last counted evening (a stock is a level, not a sum).
- The admin chart is hand-built SVG in its own module (`resources/js/insights-stocklist.js`), in the frame and colours of `insights.js`; it takes the width of its card.
- `_chart.blade.php`: a series of fewer than five steps keeps bar-width bars over their own labels (the first days after the first count), a single-layer chart does not repeat its total as a split, and a step without a count reads "nog niet geteld" in the readout instead of 0.
- Not cached on either screen: today's count is one indexed query and the rest is a small table.

## Business rules

- R P2-10.28: the daily count and its definition, and why there is no history before the first count.
- R P2-10.29: the block on Beheer > Inzichten.
- R P2-13.11: the block on the garage's own Inzichten.

## Tests

- `TheStocklistIsCountedEveryDayTest`: the count against a fixture with one car of every kind that is not on the stocklist (sold, for export, incomplete, accident, flag off, once put up for bidding, soft-deleted, demo garage, garage without module 2) and another garage; one count per day and a second run replaces the first; the series starts at the first count with a gap for an evening without one and no `estimated` key; the 30-day comparison; months over a long span; the admin data and the card.
- `AGarageSeesItsOwnFiguresTest`: the stocklist block holds only the garage's own cars, with a second garage that has more.
- `InsightsKeepTheirRulesTest`: the new block is held to the component rules (answer sentence, one bold number, icon in the served theme, chart shows a step only after a tap).

## After deploy

The migration runs with the deploy. The first row is written that evening at 23:50; until then both screens show today only. `php artisan stocklist:size-daily` can be run by hand to start the series right away.
params.title: Cars on the stocklist over time: a daily count, on Inzichten and on the garage's own page
